2607.28236.title: CDAE: Enhancing Perturbation Robustness in Pretrained Language Models with Contrastive Denoising
2607.28236.paper_summary: Pre-trained language models have significantly improved sentence representation learning, yet their embedding remain sensitive to semantic preserving textual perturbations such as synonym substitution, masking and word dropout. This work proposes a lightweight Contrastive Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE) that refines pre-trained BERT embedding by jointly optimizing contrastive and reconstruction objective to learn perturbation-invariant representation. We evaluate the proposed framework using multiple perturbation strategies with varying strengths and compare it against the original BERT embeddings and SimCSE. Experimental results show that CDAE consistently preserves higher embedding similarity under perturbations, with the improvements becoming more pronounced as framework effectively enhances representation stability while preserving semantic information, highlighting perturbation-invariant learning as a promising direction for improving sentence embeddings. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/ComputationIASBS/CDAE
2607.28236.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練語言模型顯著改善了句子表示學習，但它們的嵌入仍然對語義保持的文本擾動（如同義詞替換、遮罩和單詞丟棄）敏感。這項工作提出了一種輕量級的對比去噪自編碼器（CDAE），通過聯合優化對比和重建目標來改進預訓練的BERT嵌入，以學習擾動不變的表示。我們使用多種擾動策略和不同強度評估所提出的框架，並將其與原始BERT嵌入和SimCSE進行比較。實驗結果顯示，CDAE在擾動下始終保持更高的嵌入相似性，隨著框架有效增強表示穩定性同時保留語義信息，改進變得更加明顯，突顯了擾動不變學習作為改善句子嵌入的一個有前景的方向。源代碼可在以下網址公開獲得：https://github.com/ComputationIASBS/CDAE
